verification.windowsRuntime: art/verification/run-025-v10/runtime-results.json: Windows 构建 build_6b2f1936c854：三章通关、键盘启动、行走、暂停恢复、重开、结尾返回、归一化滚轮及既有碰撞／接地检查通过；16/16 主石指定方向探测通过。两只实际蒙皮鞋底共 220 个静止采样，最小净空 0.001375 m，此数据不覆盖所有动态姿态。

verification.performance: Intel(R) Iris(R) Xe Graphics / 1440×900 原生短样本：菜单 60、总览 60、漫步视角 47.7、近景 60、末段 47.2 FPS。网页各视角 6×500 ms 前台区间指标中位：停步后的漫步视角 35.09、结尾 53.89。这是短时视角样本，不是持续行走平均、全程最低或独立渲染帧计数；录像帧率不作为游戏 FPS，也不据此宣称版本间性能提升。
verification.shaderChecks: Original stone texture/triplanar shallow relief; Foliage Fixed40 auxiliary wind and normal consistency; 20% candidate not adopted. No new GPU profile and no unmeasured zero-cost claim.
verification.historicalPortrait: verification/web-v9-portrait-video/ is v9 historical evidence, not a v10 portrait re-test.
verification.rejectedGroundCandidate: verification/v9-ground-contact-study/review.zh-CN.txt: root contact albedo candidate rejected; original ground remains. Earlier encoded-vs-linear darkening labels corrected in retained audit.
verification.scrollInput: Existing normalized .35 metres/step and 2.5–10 clamp retained; current native forward/reverse-step QA passed. No separate current web portrait/wheel review claimed.
verification.fixedDiagnostics: 独立固定诊断：art/verification/v10-stone-study/、v10-foliage-study/、v10-silhouette-candidate/。固定时间、摆位与近镜只支持对应条件下的对照，不冒充正常游玩、动态或性能验证；A/A 存在非零差异，不称像素完全相同。
verification.finalVisualComparison: 固定 A/B 中，主石层理和粗糙感更清楚；角色发缘、肩袖和裤腿轮廓有所改善。植被采用通道同步的 Fixed40，20% 法线混合候选未采用。花草与地面衔接、头发和衣料仍有简化，整体视觉超过参考站的目标尚未证实。
